v4.6.40 — Run your IBKR bots 24/7 on the cloud (no need to keep TWS/Gateway open)

✨ NEW — IBKR bots can now run on the APEX cloud server, around the clock
• Previously, IBKR bots had to run locally with TWS or IB Gateway open on your computer. Now APEX can run a private IB Gateway for you on the cloud server — logged into your PAPER account — so your IBKR bots keep trading even with your laptop closed.
• Set it up in Tools → IBKR → 'CLOUD 24/7 · RUN ON ORACLE': enter your IBKR paper username + password, tick 'Run IBKR bots on Oracle', and click Save & sync. Your login is stored ENCRYPTED on the server and used only to start your gateway.
• Then tick 'Run on Oracle 24/7' for each bot (Tools → Automation) and press ▶. Your bots trade your IBKR paper sub-portfolios on the cloud.

⚠ Paper only: live IBKR accounts require IBKR Mobile 2FA on every login, which can't be approved on a head-less server. Leave the toggle off to keep IBKR bots running locally as before.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
